scope: Pure-H source input and composition-limit extension for cold gas opacity and atmosphere matching. No change to supported opacity nodes or to stellar time/energy tolerances.

native_opacity.scope: Native opacity values and T/rho derivatives throughout all cells and eight compositions, including the new direct pure-H source plane. No source-domain extrapolation.

atmosphere.scope: Native T/P and T,g derivatives of the selected atmosphere wrapper. Matching density is checked separately in the integrated-envelope tests; this native probe deliberately substitutes a constant density.

integrated_envelope.scope: Full20pressure-step nominal-opacity envelope with actual SCVH composition-dependent density; trace-He0 through ten times current amount at fixedTeff/radius. Source remains measured X=.999999 for trace-limit T/P. Not a cooling-age uncertainty bound.

limitations: Pure-H opacities are calculated directly. Cold atmosphere matching T/P still uses the explicitly declared one-ppm-He source limit; integrated density uses actual H/He abundances.
No added dense-fluid correction, grain opacity or three-body CIA.
Composition sensitivity is not a cooling-age uncertainty bound.
